raw_responses.Bulgarian:
This line chart illustrates the variation in maximum activation values across different layers of a neural network, comparing four distinct output components: attention output, attention residual, feed-forward network output, and feed-forward network residual. The horizontal axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks at integer intervals, indicating discrete layer indices. The vertical axis, labeled “Max Activation Value,” ranges from 0 to 1600, with major gridlines and labels at intervals of 200. Four data series are plotted: “attn_output” is represented by a blue dashed line with circular markers, “attn_residual” by an orange dotted line with circular markers, “ffn_output” by a green dash-dot line with circular markers, and “ffn_residual” by a red solid line with circular markers. The “ffn_residual” line remains near zero until layer 5, then sharply rises to approximately 1400, plateaus until layer 14, rises slightly to 1600 around layer 15, remains flat until layer 20, then drops sharply to about 400 at layer 21 and rises again to 600 at layer 22. The “attn_residual” line follows a similar pattern but with a slightly delayed rise and a peak around 1550 at layer 15, then drops to 1400 at layer 20 and falls sharply to 200 at layer 21 before rising to 300 at layer 22. The “ffn_output” line remains near zero until layer 5, rises to about 1300, drops sharply to near zero at layer 6, remains low until layer 13, rises to about 100 at layer 14, drops again, and then rises to 1200 at layer 21 before falling to 600 at layer 22. The “attn_output” line remains near zero until layer 20, then rises to 200 at layer 21 and 300 at layer 22. All lines show minimal activity in early layers, followed by sharp increases and fluctuations in later layers, with the “ffn_residual” and “attn_residual” lines exhibiting the highest peak values.

The y-axis, labeled “Max Activation Value,” ranges from 0 to 1600 with linear scaling and major tick marks at intervals of 200. The ffn_residual series, shown as a solid red line, remains near zero until layer 5, jumps to approximately 1400, stays near 1500 through layer 20, then drops sharply to about 400 at layer 21 before rising to approximately 600 at layer 22.
